framing.lineOfInquiry: Amit Sharma (P00002) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE008
framing.alternate: Amit Sharma (P00002) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Someone else used the phone or handset
alternateHypotheses.statement: Some records attributed to Amit Sharma were generated by another person using the same phone or handset.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Handset IMEI-350292334511009 is also used by P00311 — another person may have generated some records

alternateHypotheses.test: Handset forensics and SIM CAF/KYC; establish who carried the handset at the incident time (the other user's location, CCTV).

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Amit Sharma was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
